title: Panel: Energy Storage & Grid-Scale Batteries: The Next Frontier
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for a panel on energy storage and grid-scale batteries (Nov 11, 2026) with Iola Hughes (Benchmark) and Min Tang (RKP Global). No transcript; the agenda says it covers how the ESS market is growing, which chemistries are winning, and the infrastructure investment the future grid will need.

themes.theme: ESS as the next battery demand frontier

insights.claim: A Benchmark Week 2026 panel billed energy storage and grid-scale batteries as "the Next Demand Frontier" for the battery market.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Min Tang, Director, RKP Global
insights.so_what: Framing ESS as the next demand frontier points to stationary storage as a growth driver for battery materials beyond EVs.
insights.quote: Panel: Energy Storage, Grid-Scale Batteries & the Next Demand Frontier

insights.claim: The Benchmark Week 2026 ESS panel with Iola Hughes and Min Tang of RKP Global addresses how the ESS market is growing, which battery chemistries are winning, and the infrastructure investment the future grid will need.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Min Tang, Director, RKP Global
insights.so_what: Chemistry share in ESS and grid capex needs set which materials and suppliers benefit from storage growth.
insights.quote: How the ESS market is growing, which chemistries are winning, and the infrastructure investment the future grid will need.

insights.claim: The ESS panel video is member-only, so the page does not say which chemistries are winning or how large the infrastructure needs are.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Min Tang, Director, RKP Global
insights.so_what: Specific chemistry and capex conclusions are behind the paywall.
